snippet.title: Lone Tower Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
I want to wish you all a Merry Christmas & Happy Holidays!

Also wanted to share some special news - Lone Tower is officially coming to Steam and PC! 

The game is being rebuilt from the ground up with full controller and Keyboard/Mouse support. There will be way more enemies, crafting, farming, cards, world exploration, lore & story, and much (much) more! I've been working on this for quite awhile and am incredibly excited to finally start sharing it.

You can wishlist Lone Tower on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4238180/Lone_Tower/
